## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login works on staging with Fernhill's IdP. The RelayState fix (a short opaque ID stored in Redis) is in 6d0e2b8, and JIT provisioning creates users in the `fernhill` tenant with the viewer role. Group-to-role mapping is in f4a91c7, in PR #421, which is still open. PR #415 (JIT provisioning) is merged. The remaining blocker is Fernhill IT adding the groups claim before the demo on Thursday 19 Nov, 10:00 ET. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-11, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 (group-to-role mapping and short RelayState) is open, and the mapping applies on every login, not only at creation. (source: s3-06, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [prochaine-étape] Get Fernhill IT to add the groups claim, which is still pending. (source: s3-05, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] Once the claim exists, test `kestrel.test1` and one admin test account on staging, then run the demo Thursday 10:00 ET. (source: s3-08, s3-10)
- [essai-raté] SP-initiated login failed on Fernhill's ADFS: the 143-byte RelayState exceeds its 80-byte limit (MSIS7042). A short opaque ID fixed it. (source: s3-02, s3-04)
- [essai-raté] A JIT test failed on email case mismatch; the domain is now normalized to lowercase. (source: s2-02)
- [question] Fernhill's Slack message says the groups claim comes after the demo, but the checklist expects it before. Its message also asks for IdP-only login and an analyst default, which the decisions below contradict. (source: src-slack-fernhill, src-linear-kes311)
- [décision] SAML only, no OIDC for now. (source: s1-03)
- [décision] New users get the viewer role by default. (source: s1-05)
- [décision] JIT creates users only from verified domains. (source: s2-03)
- [décision] Viewer stays the default role, and SP-initiated login stays on. (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Members of Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins map to admin, everyone else to viewer. (source: s3-05)
